learning_outcomes.text: Distinguish the basic physical and electrical properties of semiconductors.
Understand the structure and operating principles of different diode types and distinguish signal analyses in various applications.
Distinguish the structure, operating principle, and DC analyses of bipolar junction transistors (BJTs).
Perform small-signal analyses of BJT type transistors.
Distinguish the basic structure and applications of operational amplifiers.

syllabus_topics: Diodes and types of diodes, half-wave and full-wave rectifiers
Diode Applications; Series diode structure, parallel and series-parallel structures
Diode Applications; AND/OR gates, sinusoidal signals
Structure and operating principles of transistors
assessment_rules: Midterm and final exam dates are not specified in the 14-week course schedule. Midterm and final exam dates are held on the dates specified in the academic calendar by the decision of the University Senate.
